CREATE TABLE "public"."brand_asset" (
  "assetId" text NOT NULL,
  "basis" text DEFAULT 'RECOGNIZED_ASSET' NOT NULL,
  "confidence" text DEFAULT 'LOW' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "evidenceIds" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "origin" text DEFAULT 'EXTRACTED' NOT NULL,
  "profileId" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceIds" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_basis_check_0cb76274" CHECK ("basis" IN ('INFERENCE', 'GENERAL_EXTRACTION', 'RECOGNIZED_ASSET', 'DESIGN_TOKEN', 'EXPLICIT_GUIDELINE', 'USER')),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_confidence_check_15ae8318" CHECK ("confidence" IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW')),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_evidenceIds_elem_not_null_4d0cb530" CHECK (array_position("evidenceIds", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_origin_check_4f78d06c" CHECK ("origin" IN ('EXTRACTED', 'INFERRED', 'USER')),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_role_check_c9adb556" CHECK ("role" IN ('LOGO', 'PRIMARY_LOGO', 'MARK', 'WORDMARK', 'ICON', 'FAVICON', 'PATTERN', 'TEXTURE', 'ILLUSTRATION', 'PHOTOGRAPHY_STYLE')),
  CONSTRAINT "brand_asset_sourceIds_elem_not_null_07253a8e" CHECK (array_position("sourceIds", NULL) IS NULL)
)
